notes.title: Demo Updates!
notes.notes:
HUGE thank you to everyone who submitted feedback, especially those who filled out the survey!

This update contains the following fixes and features:

[list]
[*]press [b]SPACE to switch[/b] between the scene and the conclusion screen
[*]DRAG and DROP to [b]organize words[/b] in the word bank
[*]click and hold the [b]SKIP button[/b] to skip the new intro video
[*]click the [b]LIGHT BULB icon[/b] on the conclusion screen to access hints or [b]highlight which blanks are wrong[/b]
[*]fixes bug where some players had to reset their progress twice to clear out all levels
[*]fixes typo on Level 1
[/list]

Keep your feedback coming!

notes.title: Begin cracking the Case of the Worst Day Ever!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that the demo is now available for The Case of the Worst Day Ever!

We can't wait to hear your feedback as we continue to improve and develop the game in the coming months. Thank you for your support!
